findings.title: Slice end off by one, omits last item of page
findings.explanation: The `end` index is calculated as `start + per_page - 1`, but Python slicing is exclusive of the end index. This causes each page to miss its last element.
findings.suggested_fix: Change line 6 to `end = start + per_page` (no -1). The return line can stay `return items[start:end]`.
findings.verdict_reason: The function computes end as start+per_page-1 but uses a slicing operation where the end index is exclusive, resulting in each page returning one fewer item than intended.

comments.body:
**medium** · bug · Slice end off by one, omits last item of page

The `end` index is calculated as `start + per_page - 1`, but Python slicing is exclusive of the end index. This causes each page to miss its last element.

**Suggested fix:** Change line 6 to `end = start + per_page` (no -1). The return line can stay `return items[start:end]`.
